data.fund_type: An open ended debt scheme investing in overnight securities. A Relatively Low interest rate risk and Relatively Low Credit Risk
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to generate reasonable income, with low risk and high level of liquidity from a portfolio of overnight securities having a maturity of one day. However there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved. The Scheme does not guarantee / indicate any returns.
data.asset_allocation: Overnight Securities (including Triparty Repo on Government Securities or treasury bill & Repo): 100% (Low) The scheme will invest in Triparty Repo on Government Securities or treasury bill, market repo & securities having a maturity of one day. Here one day refers to one business day.
